children: Shares of LG Electronics India Ltd. were trading lower by 3% on Thursday, November 26, after 2.05% of the company's equity changed hands in a block deal.

As many as 1.39 crore shares, representing 2.05% of the company's outstanding equity, were traded in the transaction, according to data available. The shares changed hands at an average price of ₹1,767.40 apiece, taking the total transaction value to ₹2,464 crore.
The identities of the buyers and sellers were not immediately known.
The block deal comes a day after CNBC-TV18 reported that the promoter of LG Electronics India was looking to sell up to 2% of the company's equity through a block deal worth up to ₹2,320.5 crore.

The floor price for the proposed offer was set at ₹1,709.30 per share, a discount of around 6% to the stock's closing price on Tuesday. The offer involved the sale of up to 1.358 crore shares. The seller would be subject to a 180-day lock-up period on any further sale of shares.
Shares of LG Electronics India ended 2.34% higher at ₹1,819.70 on Wednesday. The stock has gained 23% so far this year.

title: LG Electronics India shares fall as 2.05% equity changes hands in block deal
